'''''Blood Fortune: The Rise of the Sith Empire's Industrialist Families''''' was a multi-volume history of certain families within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which was written by Dr. [[Genlan Sossu]]. The third volume contained a history of the [[Dosk family]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Cadmael Benthos Dosk]].<ref name="Codex" />
